name: LoraxBench
intro: LoraxBench是一个综合性的多语言基准测试，专注于印度尼西亚语和19种印度尼西亚本地方言，涵盖了6种不同的自然语言处理任务。该基准测试包含了特定语言的多种语域，强调了正式和非正式语音对模型性能的影响。LoraxBench由母语者进行专业翻译和验证，数据来源于印度尼西亚语的原创内容，因此比以英语为中心的数据更能捕捉到当地的细微差别。
build_method: 人工标注, 专家构建
task_type: 选择题, 开放式问答, 自然语言推理, 翻译, 分类
task_type_en: Multiple Choice, Open-ended QA, Natural Language Inference, Translation, Classification
intro_en: LoraxBench is a comprehensive multilingual benchmark focusing on Indonesian and 19 regional Indonesian dialects, covering six different natural language processing tasks. The benchmark includes multiple language domains, emphasizing the impact of formal and informal speech on model performance. LoraxBench is professionally translated and validated by native speakers, with data sourced from original Indonesian content, making it better at capturing local nuances than English-centric datasets.
metric_en: Accuracy, F1, Exact Match, BLEU, LLM-as-a-Judge
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Select Indonesian-source datasets for reading comprehension, open QA, NLI, causal reasoning, translation, and cultural QA"] --> B["Clean COPAL-ID and IndoCulture items and validate context removal for open-domain QA"]
    B --> C["Define 23 language and register subsets across Indonesian, 19 local languages, and three register variants"]
    C --> D["Translate Indonesian instances through professional native-speaker translators"]
    D --> E["Review translations with a second native speaker for linguistic and cultural validity"]
    E --> F["Run automatic checks for abnormal translation length and numerical inconsistencies"]
    F --> G["Re-translate flagged issues and assemble 84,895 data points"]
    G --> H["Evaluate multilingual and Indonesian-focused LLMs across tasks, languages, and registers"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["选择印尼语源数据，覆盖阅读理解、开放问答、NLI、因果推理、翻译和文化问答"] --> B["清洗COPAL-ID和IndoCulture，并验证开放问答去上下文后仍可回答"]
    B --> C["定义23个语言和语域子集，覆盖印尼语、19种本地语言和3个语域变体"]
    C --> D["由专业母语译者翻译印尼语样本"]
    D --> E["由第二位母语者审核语言准确性和文化有效性"]
    E --> F["自动检查翻译长度异常和数字不一致问题"]
    F --> G["重译被标记问题并组装84895条数据"]
    G --> H["跨任务、语言和语域评估多语言及印尼专用大模型"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2508.12459. The paper adapts Indonesian-language source datasets for six tasks, including Tydi-QA, IndoNLI, COPAL-ID, and IndoCulture; covers Indonesian plus 19 local languages with three additional register variants for 23 subsets; applies cleanup, professional native-speaker translation, second native-speaker review, and automated length/numeric consistency checks; and reports 84,895 data points.
